name: MTDC Resort Bhandardara
why_special: Maharashtra Tourism's lakeside resort across landscaped grounds opposite the Wilson Dam — A/C cottages and Konkan tents, in-house restaurant, the only formal accommodation with direct Arthur Lake views.

name: Anandvan Resort Bhandardara
why_special: Private 28-room resort across landscaped grounds 2 km from Wilson Dam — outdoor pool, multi-cuisine restaurant, the polished mid-range alternative to MTDC. The base for Kalsubai Peak (Maharashtra's highest at 1,646 m) and Ratangad trekkers.
